title: A Distributional Robustness Margin For Pathology Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2607.25497v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Pathology foundation models encode non-biological variation introduced by tissue preparation, staining and scanning, enabling shortcut learning that undermines generalisation across institutions. The Robustness Index (RI} was proposed to assess whether local representation geometry is dominated by biological or non-biological variation. However, its construction suffers from structural limitations that make cross-model comparison unreliable and call for a more principled metric. We introduce the Cross-confounder Robustness Margin (CRoMa), which measures, for each sample, whether biologically matched samples differing in the confounder lie closer in representation space than confounder-matched samples differing in biology. By design, CRoMa recasts robustness as a cohort-wide distribution of sample-level margins. translated_title: 病理学基础模型的分布鲁棒性边际
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.25497v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：病理学基础模型编码了由组织制备、染色和扫描引入的非生物变异，这导致捷径学习，削弱了跨机构的泛化能力。鲁棒性指数（RI）被提出用于评估局部表示几何是由生物变异还是非生物变异主导。然而，其构建存在结构性限制，使得跨模型比较不可靠，因此需要更原则性的度量。我们引入了交叉混杂鲁棒性边际（CRoMa），它针对每个样本测量，在表示空间中，生物学匹配但混杂因素不同的样本是否比混杂因素匹配但生物学不同的样本更接近。通过设计，CRoMa将鲁棒性重新定义为样本级边际的队列级分布。我们评估了来自三个基准的20个瓦片级编码器和4个幻灯片级编码器的冻结表示。
tldr: 本文提出了一种新的鲁棒性度量CRoMa，通过重新定义鲁棒性为样本级边际的分布，解决了现有RI度量的结构性限制，实现了更可靠的跨模型比较。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a novel robustness metric CRoMa, which redefines robustness as a distribution of sample-level margins, addressing structural limitations of the existing RI metric for more reliable cross-model comparison.
